name: Default — Bo3
author: sunguraa
description: A coin flip decides who starts. Teams ban two maps, pick two maps, then ban three more. The other team picks the side for each picked map. The team that did not ban last picks the side for the final map.
notes: Port Euler excluded from Season 3 ranked pool. 5 bans + 2 picks = 7 maps touched, 1 decider.
